title: Cross-case CCZ inequivalence of case-(i) relative-trace APN functions
summary: Prove that every case-(i) relative-trace APN function is CCZ-inequivalent to every function in the other five construction cases.

formal_statement.body: For every source-admissible APN function $f_{i,3i,a,b,c}$ in case (i) of Theorem 2 and every source-admissible APN function $g$ in any of cases (ii)--(vi), prove that $f_{i,3i,a,b,c}$ and $g$ are CCZ-inequivalent, or exhibit an equivalent cross-case pair.

scope.domain: CCZ-equivalence classes of the source's relative-trace quadratic APN functions
assumptions: $f_{i,s,a,b,c}(x)=a\operatorname{Tr}_m^n(bx^{2^i+1})+a^q\operatorname{Tr}_m^n(cx^{2^s+1})$ is an APN instance in the indicated case of source Theorem 2
scope.unresolved_remainder: No inspected later theorem proves the universal pairwise separation between case (i) and each of cases (ii)--(vi). The published coefficient-equivalence theorem within the $i=1$ case-(i) branch does not compare that branch with the other five cases.

progress.summary: Assertion 2 conjectures universal CCZ inequivalence between every case-(i) function and every function from the other five Theorem 2 cases.
